interface.shortDescription: Compile prompts for the right model
interface.longDescription: Turn rough drafts into lean instructional prompts without executing the underlying task. Uses the default OpenAI target unless explicitly overridden via 'target model: <name>'. Supports OpenAI, Anthropic / Claude, other providers, and model-neutral prompts; resolves current official prompting guidance when applicable; preserves scope in Refine mode and adds requirements only when Expand is explicitly requested. The final output is only the compiled prompt.
defaultPrompt: Refine this draft prompt using the skill default target.
Refine this draft for target model: <model>.
Expand this draft with requirements using the skill default target.

name: prefine
description: A prompt compiler with a default OpenAI target that refines or explicitly expands draft prompts without executing the underlying task.
